leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a Vue component that conditionally renders images based on scroll position
Configure Intersection Observer API to detect when images enter the viewport
Initialize reactive data properties to track image loading state
Bind image source attributes dynamically when elements become visible
Apply lazy loading techniques to optimize page performance
Manipulate DOM elements using Vue's template refs
Integrate loading placeholders while images are being fetched
